discussion_comments.comment_body: This still leaves arbitrary admitted public pages running in the hidden renderer. The related #63171 discussion reports a Windows passkey dialog triggered by this exact fallback path; WebRTC/popup controls do not cover that. Please remove the fallback or add and test a title-session policy that suppresses credential/WebAuthn UI before navigation.
